d:
In this ground report, Nilanjay Tiwari speaks to students at Jamia University to understand what happened during the night, why the protest continues, which demands students say are still pending, and what lies behind the reports of the agitation coming to an end.
The report captures students’ perspectives and the situation on the ground, offering a closer look at the developments, the questions that remain, and the gap between reports of the protest ending and what students say about their ongoing agitation.
